goal: Update the pinned Guix release build environment to newer upstream toolchains and build tools
Modernize release build recipes and remove deprecation warnings and obsolete packaging overrides
agreement: Verified by building and matching output hashes on x86_64 (0xB10C, willcl-ark)
Unaddressed objection: Guix time-machine fails on riscv64 with an unbound variable error (maflcko)
Unaddressed objection: build fails on aarch64 hosts due to missing headers in fixincludes (janb84, hebasto)
Unaddressed objection: codesign manifest fails due to missing python-setuptools dependency (willcl-ark)

categories.name: build
why: P2 because updating Guix release infrastructure brings newer toolchains and upstream recipe fixes
It provides durable value for deterministic release integrity and enables future compiler support
